Agentic AI governance and enterprise security move center stage as development accelerates

AI & Technology

#3 — Nvidia Embraces AI Investor Role: $40B+ in Equity Commitments Including IREN and Corning Deals — CNBC

★ Demonstrates how AI infrastructure companies are financing the entire supply chain—relevant context for understanding enterprise AI economics and investment patterns Cristiano should monitor.

This week alone Nvidia forged an agreement with data center operator IREN, giving it the right to invest up to $2.1 billion in the company, a day after Nvidia struck a pact with Corning, allowing it to invest up to $3.2 billion in the 175-year-old glass maker. To help the company grow its dominance beyond chips, Nvidia is financing the entire AI supply chain, ensuring it runs on Nvidia hardware and that there's sufficient capacity to meet demand.
